ops.body: The destructive Desired/Applied replay-on-open pattern never lived in daemonkit and cannot on the successor surface. Gate spot-checked: ensure.go:72-73 states 'The world is re-derived from the socket, the durable owner record, and launchd's own view of the LaunchAgent — never from stored intent', and git grep for a Desired-set store finds nothing but an unrelated test name. launchd.Apply verifies non-mutating first and installs only on drift. synckit's own services.db architecture (the actual field-bug site) remains that repo's concern, per the residual.
